note: The parameter interface of the flow asset. houdini/build/build_hdas.py builds the asset's parameters from this file in Mission 3; tests/unit/test_controls.py keeps it in step with the worker's command line, the contract and the receipt schema. Defaults marked proposed are Joe's to confirm in Mission 3. Explained in docs/CONTROLS.md.

inputs.name: source
inputs.label: Source
inputs.help: The plate or render to analyse.

inputs.name: mask
inputs.label: Mask
inputs.help: Optional. Pixels at 0 are marked invalid. A SAM2 mask from Neural Layer to Mask fits here.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.label: Flow
outputs.help: Forward motion from this frame to the next, converted once to Houdini units. Visualize Velocity and Distort read it.

outputs.name: valid
outputs.label: Valid
outputs.help: 1 where the flow is trusted, 0 where it is not. A flag, not a confidence.

outputs.name: backward
outputs.label: Backward Flow
outputs.help: Motion from the next frame back to this one. The worker already computes it for validity.

controls.name: luma_weights
controls.label: Luminance Weights
controls.help: How red, green and blue are weighed into the grey analysis image.

controls.name: gain
controls.label: Gain
controls.help: Multiplies the image before it is quantised to 8 bits. Raise it for dark plates.

controls.name: gamma
controls.label: Gamma
controls.help: Scene-linear plates usually want 2.2 with a gain, or they clip (FACTS M15).

controls.name: analysis_scale
controls.label: Analysis Scale
controls.help: Shrinks the analysis image. 0.5 is about 3.3x faster for about 0.08 px more error; 0.25 is about 9x faster for about 0.2 px more (FACTS M18).

controls.name: recipe
controls.label: Recipe
controls.help: The named flow recipe. Its name and source hash go in the receipt.

controls.name: backend
controls.label: Backend
controls.help: Where the recipe runs. An unavailable backend is an error on the node, never a quiet substitute.

controls.name: tolerance
controls.label: Validity Tolerance
controls.help: Pixels of forward-backward disagreement allowed. 0.5 catches narrower occlusions and flags more good pixels.

controls.name: frange
controls.label: Frame Range
controls.help: First and last frame to bake. The export writes one extra frame so the last one has a successor.

controls.name: cache_dir
controls.label: Cache Folder
controls.default_basis: beside the scene, one folder per node; proposed
controls.help: Holds analysis.####.exr, flow.####.exr and the receipts. The worker writes nowhere else.

controls.name: bake
controls.label: Bake
controls.help: Exports the analysis frames, runs the worker once for the range, and loads the result.

controls.name: verify
controls.label: Check Cache
controls.help: Asks the worker which frames are fresh, stale or missing, without computing any flow.

controls.name: state
controls.label: Cache
controls.help: Fresh, stale and missing frame counts from the last check. A missing frame is an error on the node; a stale one is a warning.

controls.name: ran
controls.label: What Ran
controls.help: Recipe, backend and OpenCV version from the newest receipt.

controls.name: encoding
controls.label: Analysis Encoding
controls.help: Share of clipped analysis pixels and grey levels used. Warns above 5% clipped or below 32 levels.

controls.name: live
controls.label: Live
controls.help: Cook the same recipe each frame without a bake. Mission 5, if its entry gate passes.
